strings.name: Brad Pitt
strings.summary: Pitt gained attention in Thelma & Louise and expanded his range in Seven and Fight Club. He co-founded Plan B and helped produce varied films, sharing the Best Picture Oscar as part of the 12 Years a Slave team and winning an acting Oscar for Once Upon a Time… in Hollywood. His divorce and family disputes with Angelina Jolie involved prolonged legal proceedings.
